The hand on the desk overlaps the panel's bottom left corner, and PlateComposite paints the warped page over the whole quad, so the composite laid the page over the fingers and the page read as if it were spilling off the tablet. Quad typed by hand, not detected. scripts/find-quad.ts stops the panel short on the left: the window reflection lifts the left third of this screen above the mask ceiling, so the blob it finds is only the darker right part and its left edge comes back at slope -3.2 instead of the true -0.96. The composite rendered with the detected quad left a wedge of generated grey panel visible between the tablet edge and the site. Corners here were read off a 1.57x crop of the plate against the same region of the failed composite, then pushed 4px outward from the centroid. TL and TR and BR agree with the detector to within 11px; BL is the corner it got wrong, and it moves from 617,1730 to 468,1638.
